name: Shimano
verdict: Shimano Inc. is a Japanese components maker whose shares are listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange; no state sits in its ownership chain. Nothing found.
note: Rated none on 2026-10-01: listed Japanese company per its own company profile; no state owner documented and no human-rights finding against the company found. Shimano's name is printed on the front of the 2026 XDS Astana jersey (also the team's groupset supplier and a UCI World Cycling Partner).
